---
title: "The local environment"
format: html
---

The edition is prepared locally. The project does not install software or
publish to the website as a side effect of rendering these instructions.

Use the project-local R environment when running the helper notebook. The
version pin and lock file belong to this directory; the website's shared data
directory remains an explicit input boundary.

```{bash}
#| eval: false
source .uvr/activate
R --version
quarto check
```

If the local R library is incomplete, stop here and repair the environment
before changing newsletter data.
